notes:
Original primary-source acquisition failed; no original statistics taken from the replication paper. Replication uses Chinese communication scholars and data-sharing intentions rather than US psychologists and badge adoption. Reported success is the authors’ effect-specific narrative comparison, mapped to the supplied vocabulary. Internal printed discrepancy: p. 11 reports β = .197, p > .001, retained literally at the supplied locator; Figure 3 (p. 10) prints .197*** with legend *** p < .001. The narrative calls the impact significant. No inequality corrected or inferred.
Source follow-up: Fresh blind extraction from the named published article; title, authors and DOI verified on first page. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Locator p. 6 corresponds to printed p. 28 (sixth PDF page). Printed coefficient is labelled β; no metric conversion was made.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Named predictor and outcome identify this structural path. Extracted printed beta without conversion; standardisation is not explicitly stated.
